# Malaka Wine

> Malaka Wine is a wine subscription from Málaga, Spain. Each month subscribers receive a box of two or three wines from small family wineries in the province of Málaga, chosen to match a taste profile they fill in online. The site is in Spanish (default) and English.

Key facts:

- Based in Málaga, Andalusia, Spain. Delivery to mainland Spain. Sales to adults (18+) only.
- Wines come from the province's five wine areas: Axarquía, Montes de Málaga, Norte de Málaga, Manilva and Serranía de Ronda, under the DO Málaga and DO Sierras de Málaga appellations.
- Typical styles: dry and sweet Moscatel de Alejandría, sweet Pedro Ximénez, rosés and light reds from the native Romé grape, and high-altitude reds from Ronda.
- The service is pre-launch: the plans, prices and wineries currently shown on the homepage are sample content and should not be quoted as real offers.
- The name comes from Malaka, the Phoenician name of the city of Málaga.

## Main pages

- [Inicio (español)](https://malakawine.com/): la suscripción, cómo funciona, planes y preguntas frecuentes
- [Home (English)](https://malakawine.com/en): the subscription, how it works, plans and FAQ
- [Test de gustos](https://malakawine.com/taste) / [Taste quiz](https://malakawine.com/en/taste): two-minute quiz that recommends a plan
